title: Base Instance
$comment: SCOPE: structure only — field presence, types, enum membership, ranges, nullability. No cross-field logic is enforced here; that lives in validators/ (later task, with unit tests). Rules recorded but NOT implemented by this schema: (6) hi_variant_collapsed on a derived record may be true only when this base's pii[].type is one of the six non-transliterable categories (PHONE, EMAIL, PAN, AADHAAR, UPI_ID, BANK_ACCOUNT) per guidelines.md §4.3 — not checkable from the base instance alone. (7) address_structure must be non-null iff an ADDRESS entry is present in pii[] (guidelines.md §7.3 / PROJECT_SPEC.md §13). See annotation/open_questions.md for an open question on whether hard-negative bases (PROJECT_SPEC.md §12.2, 20 bases 'not part of the 100') are represented as base_instance objects with pii: [] or do not use this schema at all — pii minItems is left at 0 pending that resolution.

base_id.description: Permanent, never reused. E.g. PAN_001, NEG_007 (PROJECT_SPEC.md §12.2).

base_pii_value.description: Canonical form. Never changes across derived-record variants (guidelines.md §4.4).

name_deva.description: Deterministic transliteration, fixed at base-instance creation (guidelines.md §4.5).
